name: Liberland

flag.description: A yellow field with a black horizontal stripe across the middle and a coat of arms in the centre: a shield with a tree on dark red above a black bird and an orange sun on white, over a band of blue.
flag.symbolism: Yellow is said to stand for libertarianism and the black stripe for rebellion; in the arms, the blue stands for the Danube.

hook: Liberland is golden yellow with a black stripe through the middle and a small shield of tree, bird and sun pinned on top.
trivia: Vít Jedlička proclaimed Liberland on 13 April 2015 on Gornja Siga, a strip of Danube floodplain that neither Croatia nor Serbia claims.
No state recognises Liberland, and Croatian police control access to the land it claims.
